dol: dol gives a dict-like (MutableMapping) interface to stored data, so files, databases, and cloud blobs all read and write like a Python dictionary.
vd: vd is a vector-database facade: vector similarity search with Mongo-style metadata filters over many swappable storage backends.
ef: ef (Embeddings Flow) provides tools for workflows involving semantic embeddings: segment text, embed it with a model, cache the vectors, and retrieve.
i2: i2 has tools to inspect and manipulate Python functions, their signatures, and their call behavior, so callables can be wrapped and re-dispatched.
meshed: meshed links functions together into a callable computational graph, wiring each function's outputs into the inputs of the next.
graze: graze caches web content to local files so repeated downloads of the same URL are served from disk instead of fetched again.
creek: creek wraps streaming and iterable data sources with a uniform interface for reading elements one at a time.
